scope: Local opt-in transaction diagnostics; not native or release qualification

single_message.limitations: Successful publisher sessions only. Matches by database/backend and complete per-connection message sequence. Server time includes parsing, fences, SQL and transaction finalization; residual includes transport and scheduling, not CPU time. Connection times must not be summed per batch.

split_phases.limitations: Successful publisher sessions only; orphan spawns may be unfinished or failed and are retained in coverage. Matches by database/backend and complete per-connection message sequence. Summary phase is message or commit; split phases add round trips and cannot be compared as performance with single-message transactions. Server time is not CPU time; residual includes transport and scheduling. Connection times must not be summed per batch; startup estimate uses millisecond wall-clock timestamps.

inference: Local successful publication transactions spend most measured server time in finalization. Native failed-run cause remains unconfirmed; split phases add round trips and are not a speed comparison. Generation fencing, worker startup and transport are not the dominant measured local publication cost.

default_path.scope: New diagnostic archive with tracing and profiling disabled; local focused regression only

native_amd64.limitations: Successful publisher sessions only; orphan spawns may be unfinished or failed and are retained in coverage. Matches by database/backend and complete per-connection message sequence. Summary phase is message or commit; split phases add round trips and cannot be compared as performance with single-message transactions. Server time is not CPU time; residual includes transport and scheduling. Connection times must not be summed per batch; startup estimate uses millisecond wall-clock timestamps.
native_amd64.decision: Retain the valid latency failure. Commit/finalization dominates measured native publication time; instrument metadata preparation, upload completion and remaining durability waits next. This phase diagnostic does not qualify uninstrumented defaults or establish a single internal commit bottleneck.
